description: The file defines a PHP class 'Translation' within the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Event' namespace. It contains methods to add tasks related to translation data management, including adding, editing, and deleting translations, which are triggered after specific model actions. The class interacts with the model 'setting/task' to add these tasks, facilitating asynchronous or deferred processing of translation updates.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: A controller class handling event-based operations for translation management, specifically adding tasks after translation-related operations to process translation data.

methods.name: addTranslation
methods.description: Adds a task to generate new translation data after a translation is added.

methods.name: editTranslation
methods.description: Adds a task to regenerate translation data after a translation is edited.

methods.name: deleteTranslation
methods.description: Adds a task to handle cleanup or update after a translation is deleted.
